headline: Motorway vignettes will stop getting more expensive: amendment approved by the Chamber of Deputies
summary: The Chamber of Deputies approved a government amendment ending the annual valorization of motorway vignette prices, with coalition votes. The opposition called the move populist.
why: Motorway vignette fees are a road-use charge, and their indexation affects transport costs and state road-funding revenue.
